    72  void RawImageData::createData() {
    73    static constexpr const auto alignment = 16;
    74
    75    if (dim.x > 65535 || dim.y > 65535)
    76      ThrowRDE("Dimensions too large for allocation.");
    77    if (dim.x <= 0 || dim.y <= 0)
    78      ThrowRDE("Dimension of one sides is less than 1 - cannot allocate image.");
    79    if (data)
    80      ThrowRDE("Duplicate data allocation in createData.");
    81
    82    // want each line to start at 16-byte aligned address
    83    pitch = roundUp(static_cast<size_t>(dim.x) * bpp, alignment);
    84    assert(isAligned(pitch, alignment));
    85
    86  #if defined(DEBUG) || __has_feature(address_sanitizer) ||                      \
    87      defined(__SANITIZE_ADDRESS__)
    88    // want to ensure that we have some padding
    89    pitch += alignment * alignment;
    90    assert(isAligned(pitch, alignment));
    91  #endif
    92
    93    padding = pitch - dim.x * bpp;
    94
    95  #if defined(DEBUG) || __has_feature(address_sanitizer) ||                      \
    96      defined(__SANITIZE_ADDRESS__)
    97    assert(padding > 0);
    98  #endif
    99
   100    data = alignedMallocArray<uchar8, alignment>(dim.y, pitch);
   101
   102    if (!data)
   103      ThrowRDE("Memory Allocation failed.");
   104
   105    uncropped_dim = dim;
   106
   107  #ifndef NDEBUG
   108    if (dim.y > 1) {
   109      // padding is the size of the area after last pixel of line n
   110      // and before the first pixel of line n+1
   111      assert(getData(dim.x - 1, 0) + bpp + padding == getData(0, 1));
   112    }
   113
   114    for (int j = 0; j < dim.y; j++) {
   115      const uchar8* const line = getData(0, j);
   116      // each line is indeed 16-byte aligned
   117      assert(isAligned(line, alignment));
   118    }
   119  #endif

    35  // This allows to specify the nuber of bytes that each Buffer needs to
    36  // allocate additionally to be able to remove one runtime bounds check
    37  // in BitStream::fill. There are two sane choices:
    38  // 0 : allocate exactly as much data as required, or
    39  // set it to the value of  BitStreamCacheBase::MaxProcessBytes
    40  #define BUFFER_PADDING 0UL
    41
    42  // if the padding is >= 4, bounds checking in BitStream::fill are not compiled,
    43  // which supposedly saves about 1% on modern CPUs
    44  // WARNING: if the padding is >= 4, do *NOT* create Buffer from
    45  // passed unowning pointer and size. Or, subtract BUFFER_PADDING from size.
    46  // else bound checks will malfunction => bad things can happen !!!
    47
    48  /*************************************************************************
    49   * This is the buffer abstaction.
    50   *
    51   * It allows access to some piece of memory, typically a whole or part
    52   * of a raw file. The underlying memory may be owned by the buffer or not.
    53   * It supports move operations to properly deal with owneship transfer.
    54   * It intentionally supports only read/const access to the underlying memory.
    55   *
    56   *************************************************************************/
    57  class Buffer
    58  {
    59  public:
    60    using size_type = uint32;
    61
    62  protected:
    63    const uchar8* data = nullptr;
    64    size_type size = 0;
    65    bool isOwner = false;
    66
    67  public:
    68    // allocates the databuffer, and returns owning non-const pointer.
    69    static std::unique_ptr<uchar8, decltype(&alignedFree)> Create(size_type size);
    70
    71    // constructs an empty buffer
    72    Buffer() = default;
    73
    74    // Allocates the memory
    75    explicit Buffer(size_type size_) : Buffer(Create(size_), size_) {
    76      assert(!ASAN_REGION_IS_POISONED(data, size));
    77    }
    78
    79    // creates buffer from owning unique_ptr
    80    Buffer(std::unique_ptr<uchar8, decltype(&alignedFree)> data_,
    81           size_type size_);
    82
    83    // Data already allocated
    84    explicit Buffer(const uchar8* data_, size_type size_)
    85        : data(data_), size(size_) {
    86      static_assert(BUFFER_PADDING == 0, "please do make sure that you do NOT "
    87                                         "call this function from YOUR code, and "
    88                                         "then comment-out this assert.");
    89      assert(!ASAN_REGION_IS_POISONED(data, size));
    90    }
    91
    92    // creates a (non-owning) copy / view of rhs
    93    Buffer(const Buffer& rhs) : data(rhs.data), size(rhs.size) {
    94      assert(!ASAN_REGION_IS_POISONED(data, size));
    95    }
    96
    97    // Move data and ownership from rhs to this
    98    Buffer(Buffer&& rhs) noexcept
    99        : data(rhs.data), size(rhs.size), isOwner(rhs.isOwner) {
   100      assert(!ASAN_REGION_IS_POISONED(data, size));
   101      rhs.isOwner = false;
   102    }
   103
   104    // Frees memory if owned
   105    ~Buffer();
   106
   107    Buffer& operator=(Buffer&& rhs) noexcept;
   108    Buffer& operator=(const Buffer& rhs);
   109
   110    Buffer getSubView(size_type offset, size_type size_) const {
   111      if (!isValid(0, offset))
   112        ThrowIOE("Buffer overflow: image file may be truncated");
   113
   114      return Buffer(getData(offset, size_), size_);
   115    }
   116
   117    Buffer getSubView(size_type offset) const {
   118      if (!isValid(0, offset))
   119        ThrowIOE("Buffer overflow: image file may be truncated");
   120
   121      size_type newSize = size - offset;
   122      return getSubView(offset, newSize);
   123    }
   124
   125    // get pointer to memory at 'offset', make sure at least 'count' bytes are accessable
   126    const uchar8* getData(size_type offset, size_type count) const {
   127      if (!isValid(offset, count))
   128        ThrowIOE("Buffer overflow: image file may be truncated");
   129
   130      assert(data);
   131      assert(!ASAN_REGION_IS_POISONED(data + offset, count));
   132
   133      return data + offset;
   134    }
   135
   136    // convenience getter for single bytes
   137    uchar8 operator[](size_type offset) const {
   138      return *getData(offset, 1);
   139    }
   140
   141    // std begin/end iterators to allow for range loop
   142    const uchar8* begin() const {
   143      assert(data);
   144      assert(!ASAN_REGION_IS_POISONED(data, 0));
   145      return data;
   146    }
   147    const uchar8* end() const {
   148      assert(data);
   149      assert(!ASAN_REGION_IS_POISONED(data, size));
   150      return data + size;
   151    }
   152
   153    // get memory of type T from byte offset 'offset + sizeof(T)*index' and swap byte order if required
   154    template<typename T> inline T get(bool inNativeByteOrder, size_type offset, size_type index = 0) const {
   155      return getByteSwapped<T>(
   156          getData(offset + index * static_cast<size_type>(sizeof(T)),
   157                  static_cast<size_type>(sizeof(T))),
   158          !inNativeByteOrder);
   159    }
